newsitem.title: UK: BT announces 214 mln stg price cuts for calls.
newsitem.headline: BT announces 214 mln stg price cuts for calls.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc on Tuesday announced reductions totalling 214 million stg to the cost of national and international calls.

BT said that from next month it would cut 20 percent off the cost of national (over 35 miles) evening and nightime calls during the week and cut 10 percent off the cost of daytime national calls during the week.
It also said it would reduce the price of "many international calls".

"Residential customers and businesses can benefit from these latest BT price cuts...Our customers have already enjoyed across-the-board cuts to most calls over the past three years and there will be more to come over the next few months," BT's chief executive Peter Bonfield said in a statement.
BT said the latest cuts would bring "total price cuts to more than 1.5 billion stg in just three years".
